messages:
Eli: quick follow-up from the postmortem — recurring OOMs on infer workers, suspected slow per-shard growth + fragmentation. need owners for short fixes and longer profiling.

Eli: action list (claim or react):
  1) continuous heap snapshots + jemalloc stats across bad hosts (owner?) ETA 72h
  2) per-shard soft cap + background eviction (owner?) ETA 5d
  3) allocator tuning investigation (malloc_conf, arenas) (owner?) ETA 10d
  4) memory-drift dashboard + alert (owner?) ETA 3d
  5) update oncall runbook + repro steps (owner?) ETA 4d

Nora: I'll take 1) and upload samples to INF-1560. I'll run pprof every 5m on canaries.

Ben: picking 2) + 3). will make eviction non-blocking and add metrics. will prototype malloc_conf in a gated canary.

Eli: Nora, paste the capture commands so infra can wire a cronjob.

Nora: gist below (full script in ticket):
```
PODS=$(kubectl get pods -l app=infer -o jsonpath='{.items[*].metadata.name}')
for p in $PODS; do
  kubectl exec $p -- sh -c "pprof -raw /proc/self/exe /tmp/heap.$(date +%s).pprof" || true
  kubectl exec $p -- sh -c "cat /proc/$$/status" > /tmp/jemalloc.$p.$(date +%s).txt || true
done
```
I'll attach job once infra-bot creates it.

oncall-bot: job JOB-1123 scheduled to collect heap samples across selected canaries. next run in 3m.

Ben: note — early telemetry shows LRU metadata not expiring on some shards after warmup; that could explain steady drift. if confirmed we can ship a TTL enforcement hotfix quickly.

Eli: good. Ben, can eviction be a stop-gap while Nora validates TTL fix?

Ben: yes, eviction will be conservative and background-only. adding counters for evictions and eviction latency.

infra-bot: created ticket INF-1560 "kv-cache memory drift followup" assigned Nora, Ben, Eli.

Eli: plan recap: Nora (sampling) ETA 72h; Ben (eviction + malloc_conf pilot) ETA 5d; Eli (dashboard + runbook) ETA 4d. scheduling a 30m sync in 4 days to review results.

Nora: uploading first pprof snaps to INF-1560 now.

Ben: will open PRs for eviction and microbench; linking once ready.

Eli: thanks everyone — please update INF-1560 as tasks complete so we can close the postmortem loop. :white_check_mark:
